gloss: including all; together with; the whole ~

definitions.gloss: including all of; involving the whole (group)
definitions.explanation: Attached to a noun to mean that the whole of it is included or involved, as in a family or a whole town taking part together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ぐるみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}っている→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧。
examples.english: Our families are close friends with each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ぐるみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた→盛り上げる：07895_moriageru⟧。
examples.english: The whole town joined in to make the festival lively.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ぐるみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われていた→行う：01238_okonau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: It turned out that the fraud was not the work of a few employees but was carried out by the company as a whole.

notes:
Usually followed by で or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ぐるみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧, ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ぐるみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧. With an organization (⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ぐるみ, ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧ぐるみ) it often implies involvement in wrongdoing. The noun ぬいぐるみ (stuffed toy) is a separate word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ぐるみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧: a friendship between whole families
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ぐるみ / ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ぐるみ: the whole town / community
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ぐるみ / ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧ぐるみ: company-wide / organization-wide (often of wrongdoing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: as a whole
- 〜ごと: including, along with (リンゴ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皮|かわ}ご⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧)
